questions.question: What is the English word for "timeplan"?
questions.explanation: A timetable (or schedule in American English) is the plan showing when you have your lessons.

questions.question: What does "PE" stand for in a British school?
questions.explanation: PE stands for Physical Education - the school subject "kroppsøving".

questions.question: What is the English word for "friminutt"?
questions.explanation: "Break" (British) or "recess" (American) is the time between lessons - "friminutt" in Norwegian.

questions.question: Which phrase is a natural way to talk about a hobby?
questions.explanation: "To be into something" is a common, natural way of saying you are very interested in an activity.

questions.question: What is the head of a school called in English?
questions.explanation: The leader of a school is called the headmaster/headteacher (British) or principal (American) - "rektor" in Norwegian.
